declaration_error.what: The bird job (assets/library/bird) was declared at class level (bird, birds, goose, pájaro, ave) for a build that reads at species level. Its isolated naming read 'pigeon' 88-93 and failed because one reader wrote only the species. That reading stays FAIL; no alias is added to the bird job.
declaration_error.why_not_an_added_alias: 'pigeon' was declared for this same physical bird before any reading, in 028's script element bird-on-wire and proof P1 (block B4, 2026-11-11), and P1 passed on it. This job's aliases are only words declared for the bird before any reading (pigeon, bird, pájaro, ave) plus 'paloma', the Spanish for the declared 'pigeon'. Words that first appeared in a reader's guess (dove, seagull, duck, goose as read) are excluded.
declaration_error.forward_rule: An organic asset is declared at the level readers name (species), together with its class.
